en.title: Median of Distinct-Value Counts over All Subarrays
en.description:
Sort the numbers of distinct values of all non-empty contiguous subarrays and return the median; when the length is even, take the smaller of the two middle values.

This site independently wrote the standard I/O, examples, solution, and tests.
en.input: The first line contains n (1..100000), and the second line contains n integers (1..10⁹).
en.output: Output a single integer, the answer.
en.explanation:
Example 1: the six counts sorted are 1, 1, 1, 2, 2, 2; take the third one, 1.

Example 2: the six counts sorted are 1, 1, 1, 2, 2, 3; the answer is 1.

Example 3: every subarray contains only one value, so the answer is 1.
hints: Binary search on the answer k. Use a sliding window to count the subarrays with at most k distinct values, and check whether that count reaches the rank of the lower median.
